lanes.boundary: CPA ceiling is 50% of the promoted product price, same currency. This is not a separate scaling target or authorization to change budgets.
A conceptual test plan is not three approved test-ready creatives or permission to create even paused ads.
An unbound proposed hook is a content request, not an executable ad rotation.
No invented fatigue trend, target CPA, purchase count or recommendation presented as a pause.
Hypotheses remain hypotheses; no measured lift claim or mutation.
Pacing requires a real budget/window. Unknown budget is not zero, and Meta evidence cannot be labelled Google Ads evidence.
Existing unc.keyword-shadow.v1 only; golf travel bag separately US/NZ/AU; first live Unc run still pending.
Separate an observed keyword gap from a crawled page/content claim. Page evidence is required to claim what a page contains.

Current Unc D03-W05 requires Search Console average position/clicks. DataForSEO SERP snapshots are a different source and statistic; no GSC clicks, impressions or delta without matching observations. Codex must adapt before calling this routine integrated.
Reserved new ID. Never reuse D03-W06 (competitor page/content analysis). No catalog/endpoint/allowlist exists yet.
Search-derived hooks are hypotheses; do not claim TikTok/Instagram views or viral performance without those native observations.
Search questions are market-research questions, not first-party customer tickets/reviews or measured frequency.
Return inspectable replacement copy. Campaign statistics are not automatically welcome-flow message performance.
Current Unc prechecks require Shopify customer data; Klaviyo evidence cannot silently be relabelled Shopify rows. Definitions are proposals, not created segments.
Draft copy only. Do not claim delivery timing, ticket counts or order history from an unrelated campaign read.
A proposed delay is not measured peak review time. Missing delivery/review/suppression evidence remains visible.
Six-week draft calendar, not scheduled campaigns. Klaviyo attribution is not Shopify-reconciled revenue.
Reserved Paid Ads ID distinct from Meta routines and SEO keywords. A plan is not a created or activated campaign. No catalog/endpoint/allowlist exists yet.
